notes.title: GROTTO - NEW GAME FROM BRAINWASH GANG OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Grotto – the new game from Nongunz developer Brainwash Gang – has just launched! It's a very different experience to Nongunz, but it shares the same special brand of expertly crafted Brainwash Gang  weirdness. Check the trailer for a taster:
[previewyoutube=eRKIatBL7Zs;full][/previewyoutube]

This is what is waiting for you in Grotto...
[list]
[*] First-person narrative adventure about using divination to guide a primitive tribe
[*] Discover constellations and their meaning by drawing lines to connect stars
[*] Use other means of soothsaying: the bones of a chief, a musical instrument, a special smoking pipe
[*] Learn the stories, traditions, and hierarchies of the exotic world beyond the cave
[*] YOU have the power to decide the fate of the tribe!
[/list]
You can find full details over on the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1538850/Grotto/]Grotto store page[/url][/b], where you'll find the game ready to purchase and download with a 10% launch discount for a limited time.

Fulfill your destiny and become the Soothsayer!

Matt | Digerati

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1538850/Grotto/

notes.title: Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition is out now!
notes.content:
[b]The eternal wait is over. Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition has arrived. It's out now and ready to buy, so put your shiniest pennies into the Steam machine and let the joy and pain commence![/b]

But don't forget: if you previously owned the original Nongunz on Steam, put your shiny pennies away because the Doppelganger Edition will be added to your Steam Library free of charge. We have, however, been advised that it may take up to 24 hours after the game launches for it to appear, so if it isn't there right away, please be patient and give it some time. Thanks!

If you should happen across any issues or bugs while playing, you can drop a message into this thread: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1304780/discussions/0/3142927376025945827/]Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition | Bug Reports [/url]

Also: In addition to Steam, Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition is out now on Nintendo Switch, PS4, and Xbox One.

Huge thank you to everyone for the support along the journey to launch day. We hope you enjoy Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition!

Matt | Digerati

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304780/Nongunz_Doppelganger_Edition/

notes.title: Nongunz COMING SOON for real! Believe The Brainwash Propaganda!
notes.content:
[b]The time for Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition is nearly upon us! Yes! Yes! Yes! [/b] The game will be available to purchase, download, and enjoy the absolute heck out of from Friday, 7 May on Steam. And if Steam isn't your jam, or you just like buying games on multiple platforms for the thrill of it, you'll also be able to grab Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition on 5 May for PS4, 6 May for Nintendo Switch, and 7 May for Xbox One.

Also, some extremely good news for anyone who owns the original Nongunz (which launched in 2017 but was removed from Steam following issues related to the game's previous publisher): you will receive a copy of Doppelganger Edition into your Steam Library for no extra charge. It will be completely free. No charge. Gratis. On the house. You pay nothing. Keep your money.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38000448/0759467278513a4121e5d856840f2dc18a45f1c0.gif[/img]

As if all that wasn't enough exciting news for one day, it's also my pleasure to tell you about The Brainwash Propaganda – a special broadcast from Nongunz developer Brainwash Gang that will highlight the studio's current projects. Details below:

[b]The Brainwash Propaganda[/b]
When: Wednesday, 21 April, 2021, 6pm CEST
Where: [url=http://twitch.tv/brainwashgang]http://twitch.tv/brainwashgang[/url]

In addition to Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition, current work-in-progress titles that will feature in the showcase include [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1295790/The_Longest_Road_on_Earth/]The Longest Road on Earth[/url], and the much anticipated urban sim sandbox, Damnview: Built From Nothing. There will also be some reveals of brand new, as-yet-unannounced titles. Don't miss it!

Matt | Digerati

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304780/Nongunz_Doppelganger_Edition/

notes.title: Video: Understanding Nongunz
notes.content:
If you've played the Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition demo, you'll know Nongunz isn't like other games. It doesn't just veer from the script of conventional game design, it goes out of its way to make the script as incomprehensible as possible. 

In the video below, Digerati's head of feedback and developer relations, Steve White, takes a closer look at the enigmatic Nongunz, and how it defies expectations of how a game should work...

[previewyoutube=Mr2u6VJI-1M;full][/previewyoutube]

And if you haven't played the Nongunz demo yet – what are you waiting for!? You can [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304780/Nongunz_Doppelganger_Edition/]download it now from the game page[/url][/b].

If Nongunz appeals to you, be sure to add it to your wishlist. Also, congratulations – you are obviously a gamer with an appetite for the unusual.

Matt | Digerati

notes.title: Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition demo – grab your gun and get to the graveyard!
notes.content:
We promised there would be a Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition demo launching as part of the Steam Game Festival and – sure enough – it is available to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304780/Nongunz_Doppelganger_Edition/]download right now from the game's Steam page[/url][/b].

The demo lets you play until you defeat the first boss, which adds up to a LOT of game to sink your teeth into! It's a great introduction to the game's gothic, nihilistic world for first-time players, and also a perfect opportunity to start deciphering the riddle that is Nongunz itself. And for anyone who has dabbled in Nongunz before, the demo lets you sample the all-new Arena mode, and local co-op. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cid3Gui.gif[/img]


The demo has been released as part of the Steam Game Festival and will only be available for the duration of the event i.e. it will be removed on Monday 22nd June at 10AM PDT, so be sure to download and play the demo before then! 

If you enjoy the demo and want to stay updated about Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition, please go ahead and do any/all of the following: 
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304780/Nongunz_Doppelganger_Edition/]Wishlist Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition[/url][/b] (be notified when the game launches or goes on sale)
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304780/Nongunz_Doppelganger_Edition/][b]Follow Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition[/b][/url] (be notified whenever we post news to the Steam page)
[*] [b][url=https://www.digerati.games/newsletter]Join the Digerati mailing list[/url][/b] (stay updated on ALL Digerati games)
[/list]

Your support is really appreciated – thank you.

notes.title: Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition coming soon!
notes.content:
Welcome to the Steam page for [b]Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition[/b] – a fully remastered version of developer Brainwash Gang’s nihilistic action-platformer, Nongunz. In addition to the full, original Nongunz, which has been completely rebuilt in Unity, the Doppelganger Edition features two all-new modes: 'Arena' and local co-op. 

[b]Watch the Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition trailer:[/b]
[previewyoutube=qKf3yVX-kww;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is launching on Steam (and Switch, PS4, and Xbox One) in Q3, but you won’t have to wait that long to give it a try! A demo will be going live as part of the Steam Game Festival, which runs from 16th - 22nd June, and will be available to download from the Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition Store page. 

In addition to the demo, there is also going to be a closed beta. Stay tuned for the beta...


If you’re not familiar with Nongunz, here’s a bit of background info: the original launched on PC in 2017, but after the game’s publisher at the time – Sindiecate – vanished without a trace, the future for Nongunz looked precarious. Following a chance encounter with Brainwash Gang at 35,000 feet (they were on the same flight), Digerati jumped at the chance to pick up the rights to Nongunz, and Brainwash Gang started work on the Doppelganger Edition.

Don’t forget to [b]add Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition to your Wishlist and give the game a ‘Follow’[/b], which means you'll be alerted when the demo goes live, and can stay updated on its development and launch later this year.

Thanks for your support and we look forward to you playing Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition in the very near future!

Matt | Digerati
